dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Ten thousand waves, it's time to set sail!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Arrr! The waves be gettin' bigger! Whoa! My booty and plunder is goin' to go overboard! Strap 'er down, maties!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Matey! Matey! All hands on deck! Or else... or else I'll... I'll make ye walk the plank!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: ...I don't wanna play anymore. I'm always your "matey..."

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: So what do you wanna be?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou's so cool, but it's always Lulu that gets to be her!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: That's 'cause I'm a girl and I'm the oldest!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: But, but I'm the tallest! Boy, girl, it's all the same when you close your eyes anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: It's not the same! You don't have the same... feeling!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Oh, now you've done it! Fei is crying again...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Okay, okay... I'll let you have a turn being Beidou, okay?
